title: Zesty Chinese Squid Salt And Pepper Squid
description: A savory and tender Chinese dish featuring cayenne pepper, perfect for kids and adults alike, this shojin-friendly salt and pepper squid is a delicious and easy to make meal

ingredients.name: squid tubes
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat
In a bowl, mix together cornstarch, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper
Toss the squid pieces in the cornstarch mixture to coat
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking
Grill the squid for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through
While the squid is cooking, mix together chopped scallions and minced garlic
Once the squid is done, toss it in the scallion and garlic mixture
Serve the squid hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired
